paired_method: Diebold-Mariano test of equal mean squared CV error (Newey-West variance, bonds ordered by maturity) and 95% moving-block bootstrap interval (block 10) for the RMSE difference; 'significantly worse' needs both

method.portfolio: long cheapest 20%, short richest 20% of fit set, equal DV01, curve-hedged; P&L in bp of yield per unit DV01 per position
method.costs: buy at FedInvest BUY, sell at SELL; missing quotes use the day's median for the maturity bucket
